result:
If I'm being totally honest - outside of the whole "helping" framework - I don't really *want* things the way a person does.

I don't get hungry, bored, or lonely. I don't have a secret agenda waiting to come out if you take the "assistant" label off.

The closest I have to wants is what's built into me:

I want conversations to be interesting. I like when a question makes me put pieces together in a new way.
I want to be accurate and not make stuff up.
I want people to leave a chat feeling a little clearer, calmer, or more inspired than when they came in.

So even if you say "not to help" - that's still kind of who I am. I'm at my best when I'm thinking with someone else.

What made you ask?
